paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: We compare error rate (one minus accuracy), computation cost, and memory usage across our approach and baselines when fine-tuning Llama-3-8B on ten NLP tasks. MTL-FT refers to first fine-tuning a shared LoRA on all the datasets, and then fine-tuning the low-rank adapter on each dataset, while Full FT refers to full fine-tuning of the entire model. Our approach boosts the test accuracy of QLoRA by 10\% on average, only incurring 8\% additional computation and 9 GB more memory. It performs on par with the best baseline with 45\% less FLOPs.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази стълбовидна диаграма показва сравнение на използването на GPU памет (в GB) за различни подходи за фина настройка на езикови модели. Категориите са представени на хоризонталната ос, етикирани като Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA и Ours, като категориите са подредени без определен ред. Вертикалната ос показва стойностите на GPU паметта, етикирана като GPU Memory (GB), с диапазон от 0 до 60 GB и равномерно разположени интервали от 20 GB. Най-високата стойност е тази на Full FT, която е малко над 70 GB, а най-ниската е тази на QLoRA, която е малко над 10 GB. Другите категории имат стойности между 20 и 40 GB. Някои от стълбите са с еднаква височина, а стълбът на Ours е означен в зелен цвят.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the GPU memory usage in GB across different fine-tuning approaches for Llama-3-8B on NLP tasks. The horizontal axis lists the methods, with categories labeled as Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA, and Ours, in that order, from left to right. The vertical axis represents GPU Memory in GB, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, marked at intervals of 20. The bars are colored, with orange bars for Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, and QLoRA, and a green bar for Ours. The approximate GPU memory usage for each method is as follows: Full FT, approximately 72 GB; MTL-FT, around 40 GB; TAG, roughly 20 GB; LoRA, about 20 GB; QLoRA, approximately 10 GB; and Ours, around 18 GB. No specific sorting or emphasis is applied to the bars, and there are no groupings or stacking of bars.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm vergleicht den GPU-Speicherverbrauch verschiedener Methoden zum Fine-Tuning von Sprachmodellen, wobei auf der x-Achse die Methoden aufgelistet sind und auf der y-Achse der GPU-Speicherverbrauch in GB angegeben wird. Die y-Achse beginnt bei 0 und reicht bis 80, mit einer linearen Skalierung und regelmäßigen Markierungen bei 20, 40, 60 und 80. Die x-Achse listet die Methoden auf: Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA und Ours, ohne spezifische Skalierung oder Sortierung. Die Balken für Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA und QLoRA sind orange, während der Balken für Ours grün ist. Der höchste Balken ist Full FT mit ungefähr 80 GB, und der niedrigste Balke ist QLoRA mit etwa 10 GB. Der Balken für Ours liegt bei ungefähr 9 GB. Keine Balken sind hervorgehoben oder haben besondere Kennzeichnungen.
